output.reason: The changelog line [ev-49061bdffc5b] is vague, but the linked PR [ev-75e7107870d4] says what changed: the background cache's size-limit check was not done atomically and now is. The PR is labelled type/bug and describes the only effect as flakiness in the TestBackgroundSizeLimit test. [ev-3d5e70cd2087] shows the change touches only pkg/storage/chunk/cache/background.go and CHANGELOG.md, with no setting or flag added. Confidence is low because no effect on running deployments is described.
